name: Justice (Adl)

definition_by_age.6: Adl means treating everyone fairly, even when it's hard.
definition_by_age.8: Adl is fairness and justice in words and actions, a core Islamic value.

learning_objective: Children can describe a fair way to solve a disagreement.

recommended_default.note: Reassigned 2026-08-05 during pattern-diversity fix (was pattern_002). Two Wants Collide -> Negotiation is a direct structural match for fairness/justice — was miscategorized on generic pattern_002.

qv_006.reasoning: Verse explicitly names and commands 'adl (justice/fairness) by its own Arabic term, not an inferred connection.

hd_013.reasoning: Directly about justice/fairness, explicitly including within family — very relevant.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: A broken promise resolved fairly fits mistake-reflection too.
A friend being unfair to a smaller child fits misunderstanding->conversation.
